title: Coastal Management & Lyme Regis Case Study

flashcard_questions.q: Coastal management that involves building artificial structures to control natural processes.
Coastal management that works with natural processes to protect the coast, without building artificial structures.
A concrete or stone wall built along the coast to reflect wave energy and prevent erosion of the land behind.

flashcard_questions.a: Wooden or stone barriers built at right angles to the beach to trap sediment moved by longshore drift.
Wire-mesh cages filled with rocks, placed at the coast to absorb wave energy.
